title: TFG: Distribución del Algoritmo Random Forest mediante un Sistema Multiagente
summary: A bachelor's thesis (TFG) project implementing a distributed Random Forest algorithm using a multi-agent system (JADE) in Java, with a Flask/Python equivalent for benchmarking. The python/rows_generator.py script uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to expand a wine-quality CSV dataset into larger synthetic datasets for performance testing.
evidence: python/rows_generator.py:4-18: SingleTableMetadata detect + CTGANSynthesizer fit/sample to generate synthetic chunks of winequality data
